title: Smooth and Quiet Engine Running
summary: Feedback on this topic mainly describes the car as running smoothly, quietly, and well overall, with one complaint about poor suitability for long-distance or highway driving and many brief fragments that are too limited for clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise smooth running, quiet engine behavior, low vibration, and generally good driving feel.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the car is not recommended for long distances or highway runs.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments briefly mention that the car runs well or smoothly, but they are too short to confirm clear sentiment in context.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short and lack enough context to distinguish clear praise from undetermined mentions.
The topic includes a stray reference to seat position alongside running behavior, so not all fragments are tightly focused on engine smoothness alone.
Examples are sentiment-stratified samples and are not representative estimates of the full review population.
